claim_guard: This systematic benchmark was designed after earlier component outcomes had been inspected. It can test whether a fixed borrowing procedure preferentially repairs held-out OOD regions across a declared portfolio, identify null and harmful edges, and generate hypotheses for external confirmation. It cannot retroactively create prospective validation, establish universal transfer, or prove laboratory discovery acceleration.

eligibility.source_of_tasks_and_edges: All target tasks and all five real donor edges per target are inherited without replacement from knowledge_map_design.json.

excluded_targets.photo_z_pipi: Only five intact evaluation groups; below the frozen minimum of 12.

partition.target_development: Reuse the parent knowledge-map development indices.
partition.target_evaluation: Union of the parent discovery and confirmation indices; no target evaluation outcome is used for fitting, donor selection, or OOD assignment.
partition.formula_distance: Euclidean distance in elemental-composition features standardized using the complete target-development feature matrix only.
partition.molecule_distance: One minus the maximum exact Morgan radius-2 1024-bit Tanimoto similarity to any complete target-development molecule.
partition.entity_to_group: The median entity distance is assigned to each intact element-set or Bemis-Murcko-scaffold evaluation group.
partition.strata: Evaluation groups are sorted by distance with deterministic hash tie-breaking and divided into four approximately group-balanced quartiles. Q1 is ID-like and Q4 is OOD-like.

representation.formula: Element fractions plus eight compact composition descriptors inherited from analysis/common.py.
representation.molecule: Morgan radius-2 1024-bit fingerprint inherited from analysis/run_knowledge_map.py.
representation.donor_signal: A leakage-excluded donor model prediction evaluated at every recipient entity and injected as one additional feature.
representation.donor_training_exclusion: Every recipient evaluation material identity present in a donor task is excluded before donor fitting.

learners.note: Learners are fixed before this benchmark run; no per-edge hyperparameter search is allowed.

inference.primary_effect: gain_specific = gain_ood_q4 - gain_id_q1, where gain = (RMSE_target_only - RMSE_augmented) / RMSE_target_only.
inference.hierarchical_bootstrap: Resample target-training repeats and intact evaluation groups. A shared repeat draw is used for Q1 and Q4; group draws are nested within scope.
inference.control_contrasts: Paired target-training-repeat bootstrap for primary-versus-wrong and primary-versus-shuffled OOD-gain differences.
inference.primary_p_value: One-sided exact-or-Monte-Carlo sign-flip test on repeat-level Q4 relative-RMSE gain.
inference.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the eight designated primary donor edges.
inference.programme_bootstrap: Resample the seven independent recipient programme clusters, not individual edges.
inference.conditionality: Intervals are conditional on the frozen dataset snapshot, representations, evaluation split, and learners.

classification.ood-improvement-not-specific: Q4 improvement is positive with a positive interval, but the OOD-minus-ID or control-specificity gate fails.
classification.directional-ood-improvement: Mean Q4 improvement is positive but its interval includes zero.
classification.harmful: Mean Q4 improvement is negative and its upper interval is below zero.

cohort_gate.interpretation: Passing the cohort gate supports a reproducible selective OOD-repair method-development result. Passing the cross-database upgrade additionally supports the narrower cross-database claim. Neither substitutes for a new outcome-unseen external programme.

retention_rule: All real, shuffled, null, and harmful edge results are retained and reported.
